# InverseDesignOptimization

**Domain**: TCC
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
A computational method that automatically generates photonic device geometries by optimizing a figure of merit, often using adjoint methods or machine learning, to meet performance targets. Enables the creation of custom optical components tailored to specific interconnect topologies, reducing insertion loss and crosstalk in wafer-scale TCC networks.
